tools.name: eor_employment_cost_batch
tools.title: eor_employment_cost_batch
tools.description: Determine the total employment costs for an Employee of Record (EOR) arrangement across different countries, including salary, employer costs, benefits, and additional fees.

state.description: The state or region within the country, if applicable.

salary.description: The base salary for the employee.

currency.description: The currency in which the costs are calculated.

country_code.description: The two-letter country code where the employee is based.

country_name.description: The country where the employee is based.

salary_period.description: The salary_period frequency in uppercase format.

payment_frequency.description: The payment_frequency of the salary payment.

data.description: Array of employee cost calculation requests.

tools.name: eor_employment_cost_calculate
tools.title: eor_employment_cost_calculate
tools.description: Calculates the total employment cost for an EOR arrangement in a specified country, returning a breakdown that includes employer costs, benefits, platform fees, and severance accrual.

state.description: The state or region within the country, if applicable.

salary.description: The base salary for the employee.

country.description: The full name of the country where the employee is based.

plan_id.description: The ID of the benefits plan, if applicable.

provider_id.description: The ID of the benefits provider.

benefits.description: A list of selected benefit plans for the employee.

currency.description: The currency in which the costs are calculated.

country_code.description: The two-letter country code where the employee is based.

salary_period.description: The salary period for the amount provided.
